title: 填空的词性与词形
goal: 根据句子结构判断词性，核对原词的数与语法形式。

points.label: 根据空格前后结构判断词性
核对原词的数与语法形式

body.p: 句子填空要核对两件事：空格在句子里的位置，原文的词形。冠词、介词、助动词和并列成分都能提示空格的词性。

body.box:
The team tested two filters.
The two _____ were tested by the team.

body.p: two 后面接复数名词。原词 filters 保留复数，和 were 一致。

cards.title: 冠词与介词
rows: 冠词
The museum displayed a model of the gate beside an original drawing, allowing visitors to compare the arrangement shown in the two objects.
a model：冠词后接名词。
冠词
The researcher opened an envelope containing the results and placed it beside the notebook before comparing the figures with an earlier set of measurements.
an envelope：冠词后接名词。
冠词
The team fitted the cover over the tank after measuring its opening and recording the dimensions on a plan of the garden's water system.
the cover：冠词后接名词。
介词
The technician examined the pipe after the inspection and entered the results in a record book that remained beside the machine throughout the trial.
after the inspection：介词后接名词短语。
介词
A screen was placed between the tank and the channel to keep leaves from reaching the inlet while rainwater passed through the mesh above it.
between 后接名词短语。
介词
The conservator worked with a colleague before the display opened, and both recorded the condition of the sheet in the same catalogue entry.
with 后接名词短语。

cards.title: 助动词与并列
rows: 助动词
The team can measure the width of the opening without removing the cover, provided that the device remains accessible from the side of the tank.
can 后接动词原形 measure。
助动词
The technician has checked the valve and recorded the result in the log, which is kept near the pump for later inspection by colleagues.
has 后接过去分词 checked。
助动词
The two samples were stored in separate containers before the researchers examined their surfaces and entered the observations in a shared laboratory notebook.
were 后接过去分词 stored。
并列
The team measured and recorded the width of the frame before the model was assembled and placed beside the original drawing in the display.
measured 与 recorded 并列。
并列
The record lists the date and location of each discovery so that later researchers can trace an object to the place where it was found.
date 与 location 并列。
并列
The two lids were light and strong enough for the workers to lift them repeatedly while checking the contents of the tanks during the summer.
light 与 strong 并列作表语。

cards.title: 可数名词与词形
rows: 单数
A valve controls the flow into the tank, and a separate cover protects the opening from material falling from the roof of the workshop.
a valve 是单数。
复数
Two valves control the flow into the tank, and a separate cover protects the opening from material falling from the roof of the workshop.
two valves 是复数。
复数一致
Several records contain drawings of the bridge and descriptions of the channel, while one separate sheet lists the dates of repairs to the gate.
several records 与 contain 一致。
名词
The team recorded a change in pressure during the trial and repeated the measurement after the pump had been switched off for an hour.
a change 中 change 是名词。
动词
The pressure can change during the trial, so the team recorded a measurement before switching the pump off and checking its inlet for damage.
can change 中 change 是动词。
名词与动词
Researchers test each sample before writing a test report, which records the conditions and allows the measurements to be compared with earlier results.
test 可作动词或名词。

cards.title: 复合名词中心词
rows: A water tank stands beside the shed, where a gardener can check the level before using the stored water on plants in the surrounding beds.
water tank 的中心词是 tank。
tank 单数。
Two water tanks stand beside the shed, where a gardener can check the levels before using the stored water on plants in the surrounding beds.
water tanks 的中心词是 tanks。
tanks 复数。
Several research teams share a laboratory, but each team records its own measurements in a separate notebook before comparing the results with the other groups.
research teams 的中心词是 teams。
teams 复数。
A research team shares a laboratory with another group, and each team records its own measurements in a separate notebook before comparing the results.
research team 的中心词是 team。
team 单数。

groups.text: The archivist placed a drawing in a folder before the inspection. The drawing showed the gate before repairs.

items.stem: The archivist placed a _____ in a folder. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: 冠词 a 后接原文名词 drawing。

groups.text: The technician has checked the valve. A colleague then recorded the result in a log beside the pump.

items.stem: The technician has _____ the valve. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: has 后保留过去分词 checked。

groups.text: Two water tanks stand beside the shed. Each tank has a cover that can be removed for inspection.

items.stem: Two water _____ stand beside the shed. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: two 后用复数中心词 tanks。

groups.text: The workers measured and recorded the width of the gate before attaching a new handle to the wooden frame.

items.stem: The workers measured and _____ the width of the gate. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: recorded 与 measured 并列，保持原文过去式。

groups.text: A research team compared two water filters. The filters were stored in a cupboard before the trial. A technician can measure the flow through each filter. The technician entered the results in a notebook after the test. The team used the same instrument for both measurements.

items.stem: The filters were stored in a _____. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: 冠词 a 后接原文名词 cupboard。

items.stem: A technician can _____ the flow. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: can 后接原文动词原形 measure。

items.stem: The team compared two water _____. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: two water filters 的中心词 filters 保留复数。

groups.text: A museum team examined two wooden models of a bridge. Each model had been stored in a separate box. The curator has recorded the position of a crack on one model. A conservator can repair the crack without replacing the entire frame. The team measured and photographed both models before moving them. After the inspection, the models were placed on shelves in a dry room. The photographs remained in the museum catalogue, where staff could compare them with images made during earlier visits. The boxes were kept separately for future transport.

items.stem: Each model had been stored in a separate _____. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: a separate 后接原文单数名词 box。

items.stem: The curator has _____ the position of a crack. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: has 后接原文过去分词 recorded。

items.stem: The conservator can _____ the crack. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: can 后接原文动词原形 repair。

items.stem: The team examined two wooden _____. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: two wooden 后接原文复数名词 models。

groups.text: A research group studied water flow in a small garden. Two water tanks stood beside the shed, and a pipe joined them. The workers checked and cleaned the pipe before the trial. They recorded the flow after the cleaning. A change in pressure was noted during the first measurement. The pressure could change again when the pipe was opened, so a second measurement was taken. The results were entered in a record book. This book also contained the dates of the inspections and the names of the workers who completed them.

items.stem: Two water _____ stood beside the shed. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: water tanks 的中心词是复数 tanks，与 two 一致。

items.stem: The workers checked and _____ the pipe. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: cleaned 与 checked 并列，保留原文形式。

items.stem: The workers recorded the flow after the _____. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: after the 后接名词 cleaning。

items.stem: The pressure could _____ again when the pipe was opened. ONE WORD ONLY.
items.why: could 后接动词原形 change。
